purpose: Route-local spectral-reconstruction rows preventing spectral agreement or spectral geometry from becoming candidate identity.

spectral_reconstruction_rows.spectral_object: operator, modular, or code-subspace spectrum inside declared reconstruction domain
spectral_reconstruction_rows.reconstruction_rule: A spectrum can support only the declared route-local object unless degeneracy, isospectrality, representation dependence, operator-domain, and public-record quotients are controlled.
spectral_reconstruction_rows.residual_gap: Spectral nonuniqueness, missing eigenvectors/measure, incomplete spectral data, continuum/discrete limit movement, and observed-sector mapping remain residual.
spectral_reconstruction_rows.forbidden_inference: Do not infer full geometry, ontology, Hilbert-space closure, representation uniqueness, or candidate identity from spectral agreement alone.
